name: Mashiro Kanade
source:
"I'm inviting you to heaven."

A guitarist and vocalist with the extreme idea that if he can't sing his own songs, he'd rather die. With his voice, playing skills, and good looks, he has captivated everyone who has come to his live performances, and is considered the king of charisma.

He is a charismatic guitarist whose voice, playing skills, and beauty captivate all who come to his live performances, and he is considered the king of the world.  On the front stage, he hides his identity as a solo guitarist for instrumental songs, and has been evaluated worldwide.

[Translated from [url=https://ikemen.cybird.ne.jp/title/live/original/character/mashiro_kanade.html]official website[/url]]
